subject: rename functions - prefix should be zset not zsl (#3278)
reason: The change only renames two internal functions (zslParseLexRange -> zsetParseLexRange, zslFreeLexRange -> zsetFreeLexRange) and updates their declarations, call sites and comments. Every call site is updated identically with the same arguments and control flow; no command behavior, reply, data layout, replication or persistence path changes. A pure refactor with no behavior change needs no scenario.
